# Design Systems and Resources

This file contains links to UK government design systems and resources useful for designing internal services.

## Core Design Systems

### GOV.UK Design System (GDS)
The primary design system for UK government services.
- **Design System**: https://design-system.service.gov.uk/
- **Components**: https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/
- **Patterns**: https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/
- **Styles**: https://design-system.service.gov.uk/styles/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-frontend

### GOV.UK Service Manual
Guidance on how to design and build government services.
- **Service Manual**: https://www.gov.uk/service-manual
- **Accessibility**: https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/helping-people-to-use-your-service
- **User research**: https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/user-research

### GOV.UK Content Design Guide
- **Style guide**: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/style-guide

---

## Departmental Design Systems

### Defra
- **Defra Design**: https://design.defra.gov.uk/ (if available)
- **Defra Forms**: https://github.com/DEFRA/forms-designer

### Home Office
Particularly useful for internal services and complex user journeys.
- **Home Office Design System**: https://design.homeoffice.gov.uk/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/UKHomeOffice/design-system

### HMCTS (HM Courts & Tribunals Service)
Good patterns for internal case management systems.
- **HMCTS Design System**: https://hmcts-design-system.herokuapp.com/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/hmcts/design-system

### DWP (Department for Work and Pensions)
- **DWP Design System**: https://design-system.dwp.gov.uk/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/dwp/design-system

### MOJ (Ministry of Justice)
- **MOJ Design System**: https://design-patterns.service.justice.gov.uk/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/ministryofjustice/moj-frontend

### HMRC (HM Revenue & Customs)
- **HMRC Design Patterns**: https://design.tax.service.gov.uk/hmrc-design-patterns/

### NHS
- **NHS Design System**: https://service-manual.nhs.uk/design-system
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/nhsuk/nhsuk-frontend

---

## Internal Services Guidance

For internal users (civil servants), you can:
- Use technical terms and acronyms familiar to staff
- Design more complex interfaces (users are trained)
- Prioritise efficiency over extensive explanation
- Use the Home Office Design System patterns which are designed for caseworkers

### Home Office Accessibility Posters
- **Posters**: https://ukhomeoffice.github.io/accessibility-posters/

## Tools and Utilities

### Accessibility Testing
- **WAVE**: https://wave.webaim.org/
- **axe DevTools**: https://www.deque.com/axe/devtools/
- **Accessibility Insights**: https://accessibilityinsights.io/

### Colour Contrast Checkers
- **WebAIM Contrast Checker**: https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/
- **Colour Contrast Analyser**: https://www.tpgi.com/color-contrast-checker/

### Screen Readers for Testing
- **NVDA** (Windows, free): https://www.nvaccess.org/
- **VoiceOver** (macOS, built-in)
- **JAWS** (Windows, paid)
